welcome.title: Let's verify your identity
welcome.intro: For your safety and our drivers', Confiance verifies every rider's identity once, before their first ride.
welcome.noSession: To start, open this page from the Confiance app.
welcome.noSessionTest: Testing? Ask a staff member for a test link.
welcome.logoAlt: Confiance logo: mobility with peace of mind

steps.title: How it works
steps.consent: You read and accept how your data will be used.
steps.document: You take a photo of your ID document (front, and back if needed).
steps.selfie: You do a short camera check (turn your head, blink).
steps.result: You get the result in the app.

consent.title: Your agreement
consent.placeholderNote: This wording is for testing only. The final text will be written by our lawyer.
consent.what: Photos of your identity document (front, and back if needed). Later, a short check of your face in front of the camera.
consent.why: To confirm that you are who you say you are, for the safety of riders and drivers.
consent.how: Your photos go straight to Confiance's private storage. Only authorised staff can see them, and every view is recorded.
consent.keep: Only as long as the verification needs, then they are deleted (exact period to be confirmed).
consent.rights: You can ask to see or delete your data by contacting Confiance customer support.
consent.checkbox: I have read this information and I agree to Confiance verifying my identity with these photos.

declined.title: You did not agree
declined.body: Without your agreement we cannot verify your identity, so you cannot ride with Confiance yet. Nothing has been recorded.
declined.hint: You can close this page and return to the Confiance app.

document.title: Which document will you use?
document.intro: Choose the original document you have with you.

capture.tipSurface: Tip: hold the card straight, on a plain, dark surface.
capture.loadFailed: Check your connection, then try again.
capture.tooLittleDetail: Camera resolution too low: use another phone

hints.no_document: Place your ID straight inside the frame
hints.move_back: Move the phone back a little
hints.center_document: Centre the ID and keep it straight
hints.too_dark: Too dark: move to a brighter place
hints.glare: Glare on the ID: tilt it slightly

camera.denied: Allow Confiance to use the camera (in the browser or app settings), then try again.
camera.no_camera: We could not find a camera on this device. Use a phone with a back camera.
camera.insecure: The camera only works on a secure (https) page. Open the link from the Confiance app.
camera.busy: Another app may be using the camera. Close it, then try again.
camera.unsupported: This browser cannot use the camera. Open the link in Chrome.
camera.unknown: The camera could not start. Try again.

turnOver.title: Now the back
turnOver.body: The front is done. Turn your card over to photograph the back.

review.title: Check the photo
review.checkSharp: All the text is sharp and readable
review.refused: This photo cannot be used. Please take it again.
review.lowResolution: This photo does not have enough detail to be sent. Hold your phone upright and take it again. If this keeps happening, use another phone.
review.refusedOverride: This photo looks blurry or has glare. Take it again if you can.

upload.title: Sending your photos
upload.keepOpen: Please keep this page open while sending.
upload.failedTitle: The photos could not be sent

done.title: Photos received
done.next: Next step: face check (coming in M5).
done.close: You can now return to the Confiance app.

sessionError.invalid: This verification link is not valid or was not copied correctly.
sessionError.expired: This verification link has expired. For your security, links are only valid for a short time.
sessionError.already_submitted: The photos for this verification have already been sent.
sessionError.hint: Return to the Confiance app to get a new link.
sessionError.testHint: Testing? Ask a staff member for a new test link.
sessionError.already_submittedClose: Your photos have been received. You can return to the Confiance app.

errors.bad_request: The request was not accepted. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your access has expired. Open the link from the Confiance app again.
errors.forbidden_role: Your role does not allow this action.
errors.invalid_session: This verification link is not valid.
errors.already_submitted: The photos for this verification have already been sent.
errors.document_type_required: Please choose your ID document first.
errors.invalid_kind: This side is not needed for this document. Please choose your document again.
errors.missing_sides: A photo is missing. Please take the photos again.
errors.too_many_uploads: Too many photos were sent for this verification. Return to the Confiance app to start again.
errors.upload_missing: The photo did not arrive. Please try again.
errors.invalid_image: The photo file is damaged. Please take the photo again.
errors.image_too_small: The photo file is too small (probably blank). Please take the photo again.
errors.image_too_large: The photo file is too large. Please take the photo again.
errors.image_resolution_too_low: The photo is not detailed enough. Hold your phone upright and take it again; if this keeps happening, use another phone.
errors.audit_failed: The action could not be recorded. Please try again.
errors.invalid_invite: The email address or invite code is not valid.
errors.weak_password: The password does not meet the rules.
errors.server_error: The server had a problem. Please try again.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Check your mobile data, then try again.
errors.timeout: The server is taking too long to answer. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.not_configured: This test version is not connected to a server.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.storage_failed: The photo could not be sent. Please try again.

fatal.title: Something went wrong
fatal.text: Reload the page to continue. Your link still works.
